attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall (T1562.007)
attackers_goals: Obtaining persistency persistence by creating a direct, reliable backdoor that allows them to remotely control the system without needing to re-exploit it.
description: A cloud identity has modified the ingress rules to allow unfamiliar ip addresses SSH or RDP access.
investigative_actions: Investigate any unusual activity originating from the suspected identity and any activity performed from the newly added ip addresses.
name: AWS Security Group remote access allowed from an unknown external IP address
